plugins.name: docs-researcher
plugins.description: Version-pinned library documentation on demand: a sandboxed researcher subagent wired to the Context7 MCP (resolve-library-id / query-docs) with WebSearch fallback. Scoped to the subagent — not the orchestrator/agent base context.

plugins.name: image-gen
plugins.description: General raster image production and editing through Codex image_gen, local procedural rendering and post-processing, SVG-to-img2img polish, and background removal.

plugins.name: interaction-craft
plugins.description: How interfaces earn their feel — the motion guidance (stagger, never synchronize), perceived-performance doctrine, and the iOS mechanics behind both. Distilled from a deep read of the Telegram iOS source.

plugins.name: mindsets
plugins.description: Operating-mode skills that re-trigger the right cognitive stance for a session: researcher (generative exploration), mechanic (keep-alive / operator execution discipline), wingman (codex co-researcher collaboration), and bakeoff (undirected multi-entrant competitions for idea mining).

plugins.name: operators
plugins.description: Policy-free operator dispatch MCP tools for Codex, agy, and Cursor.

plugins.name: wingman
plugins.description: A standalone Codex co-researcher MCP plugin with reusable named sessions and journaling.
